findings.statement: The difference in conversion rates is statistically significant.
findings.code:
import scipy.stats as st
conv_B=389
n_B=3000
conv_A=296
n_A=3000
p1=conv_B/n_B
p2=conv_A/n_A
p_pool=(conv_B+conv_A)/(n_B+n_A)
z=(p1-p2)/((p_pool*(1-p_pool)*(1/n_B+1/n_A))**0.5)
print('z',z)
print('p-value two-sided',2*(1-st.norm.cdf(abs(z))))
print('p-value one-sided',1-st.norm.cdf(z))
